<style>
.main-container { max-width: 100%; margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em; }
table { width: 100%; }
</style>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, out.width = "100%")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 14))

stats <- read.delim(params$stats_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

has_params <- params$params_file != "" && file.exists(params$params_file)
if (has_params) {
  params_df <- read.delim(params$params_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Compute drop from previous step
stats$step <- factor(stats$step, levels = stats$step)
stats$dropped_seqs <- c(NA, -diff(stats$sequences))
stats$dropped_bases <- c(NA, -diff(stats$bases))
stats$pct_retained <- c(NA, round(100 * stats$sequences[-1] / stats$sequences[-nrow(stats)], 1))
```

```{r cdhit_warning, results='asis'}
if (has_params) {
  row <- params_df[params_df$parameter == "cdhit_available", ]
  if (nrow(row) > 0 && trimws(row$value) == "false") {
    cat('<div style="background:#fff3cd;border:1px solid #ffc107;border-radius:4px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:16px;">',
        '<strong>Warning:</strong> cd-hit-est was not found on PATH.',
        'Target collapse (step 2) and probe deduplication (step 7) were skipped.',
        'The probeset may contain redundant sequences.',
        'Install cd-hit to enable these steps.</div>\n\n')
  }
}
```

## Pipeline Summary

```{r summary_table, results='asis'}
display <- stats %>%
  mutate(
    Step = step,
    Sequences = format(sequences, big.mark = ","),
    Bases = format(bases, big.mark = ","),
    `Dropped (seqs)` = ifelse(is.na(dropped_seqs), "-", format(dropped_seqs, big.mark = ",")),
    `Retained (%)` = ifelse(is.na(pct_retained), "-", paste0(pct_retained, "%"))
  ) %>%
  select(Step, Sequences, Bases, `Dropped (seqs)`, `Retained (%)`)

knitr::kable(display, align = "lrrrr")
```

**Overall retention:** `r format(stats$sequences[nrow(stats)], big.mark = ",")` probes from `r format(stats$sequences[1], big.mark = ",")` input sequences (`r round(100 * stats$sequences[nrow(stats)] / max(stats$sequences[1], 1), 1)`%).

## Sequences per Step

```{r bar_chart}
ggplot(stats, aes(x = step, y = sequences)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(sequences, big.mark = ",")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Pipeline Step", y = "Number of Sequences",
       title = "Sequence Count Through Build Pipeline") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## Total Bases per Step

```{r bases_chart}
ggplot(stats, aes(x = step, y = bases)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#41ae76", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(bases, big.mark = ",")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Pipeline Step", y = "Total Bases",
       title = "Total Bases Through Build Pipeline") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r params_section, eval=has_params, results='asis'}
cat("\n\n<details><summary>Parameters</summary>\n\n")

knitr::kable(params_df, col.names = c("Parameter", "Flag", "Value"), align = "lll")

# Reconstruct CLI command
cmd_parts <- c("baitbench build-probes")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {
  flag <- params_df$flag[i]
  val <- params_df$value[i]
  if (!is.na(val) && val != "" && val != "none" && val != "false") {
    if (val == "true") {
      cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, flag)
    } else {
      cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, paste(flag, val))
    }
  }
}

cat("\n**Command:**\n```\n", paste(cmd_parts, collapse = " \\\n  "), "\n```\n")
cat("\n</details>\n")
```
